'''Darth Yun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> Yun was stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|the battle there]] but was slain in combat alongside Lord [[Feng]].

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Yun wielded two [[Color/Legends|yellow]] single-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] during combat and was also proficient in using [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Choke]] against her opponents.<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Yun is also referred to as "Darth Yuni" within the game files.
